text: Marc Stevens, a small-time singer of ballads in retirement homes, breaks down in a storm deep in the woods, [stranded with the van that is also his home|trigger|cut off and trapped]. The innkeeper Mr. Bartel, a former comedian, takes him in, warns him away from the village, and slowly comes to see in Marc [the wife Gloria who left him years ago|origin|grief that will not end]. Soon Marc is [tied to a chair in an old dress|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes], half his head shaved, while in the village bar the men dance together and [begin to share the same delusion|threat|the group turns on you].
